reviewer: Codex, visual inspection of full-size grayscale render and comparison to earlier candidates

criteria.evidence: The forms read as smooth tubes, with the wing and foreleg sharing an unconvincing attachment and visible shading discontinuities.
Upper-left light and darker undersides explain the rounded form, though the result remains overly tubular.
Recognizability and local improvements do not meet the intended standard of a convincing creature drawing.

strengths: The jaw has clear sky beneath it and the hind foot no longer merges with the tail.
weaknesses: The forms read as smooth tubes, with the wing and foreleg sharing an unconvincing attachment and visible shading discontinuities.

issues.observation: This is still an elementary construction study rather than a convincing foundation for excellent art.

comparison.evidence: The revised jaw/far-wing and hind-foot/tail gaps are visibly larger. Tail curvature is smoother and the original hard body bands are gone. These fixes improve the parent but do not establish convincing anatomy.
